Generate a timestamp-based log filename

Source: R/talaria_logging.R
TALARIA_generate_log_filename.Rd

Creates a log filename using the current date and time, suitable for automatic naming so log files sort chronologically on disk.

Usage

TALARIA_generate_log_filename(
  log_dir = NULL,
  prefix = "log",
  extension = ".log",
  format = c("compact", "readable")
)

Arguments

log_dir

Character or NULL. Directory in which to place the file. NULL (default) returns just the filename with no path.

prefix

Character. Filename prefix. Default "log".

extension

Character. File extension. Default ".log".

format

Character. Timestamp style:

"compact"

Default. YYYY_MM_DD__HH_MM — filesystem-safe, no seconds (e.g. log_2026_03_05__14_30.log).

"readable"

YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS — includes seconds (e.g. log_2026-03-05_14-30-52.log).

Value

Character string — full file path if log_dir is provided, otherwise just the filename.
